effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Lingyang melakukan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Basic Attack: Feral Roars
effects.description: Setelah menggunakan Resonance Skill Furious Punches, Basic Attack ke-5 digantikan dengan Feral Roars, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description: Lingyang mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Lingyang mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-air Plunging Attack, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Menggunakan Basic Attack setelah berhasil melakukan Dodge untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Ancient Arts
effects.description: Menyerang target, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Furious Punches
effects.description:
Ketika Basic Attack ke-3, ke-4, ke-5, atau Basic Attack Feral Roars mengenai target, Resonance Skill Ancient Arts digantikan dengan Resonance Skill Furious Punches.
- Setelah menggunakan Basic Attack Feral Roars dan Resonance Skill Furious Punches, siklus Basic Attack akan dimulai dari Basic Attack ke-3.
- Resonance Skill Lingyang tidak akan mereset siklus Basic Attack.
Menyerang target, memberikan  Glacio DMG, dan memperoleh Lion's Vigor.

effects.title: Lion's Vigor
effects.description: Lingyang mendapatkan 50%  Glacio DMG Bonus.

effects.title: Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge
effects.description: Ketika Lion's Spirit penuh, gunakan Heavy Attack untuk melakukan Glorious Plunge, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike
effects.description: Ketika Lion's Spirit tidak penuh, gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack untuk melakukan Tail Strike, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Striding Lion
effects.description:
- Setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge, Lingyang memasuki Striding Lion state.
- Jika Lion's Spirit penuh saat menggunakan Intro Skill Lion Awakens atau Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, gunakan Basic Attack untuk memasuki Striding Lion state.
Dalam Striding Lion state:
- Dapat menyerang di udara. Jika berada di tanah, gunakan Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge untuk kembali ke udara.
- Lion's Spirit terus berkurang dan habis dalam 5 detik, setelah itu Striding Lion berakhir.
- Jika berada dalam Lion's Vigor, konsumsi Lion's Spirit berkurang 50%, memperpanjang Striding Lion hingga 10 detik.
- Basic Attack digantikan dengan Basic Attack Feral Gyrate, yang dapat melakukan hingga 2 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Glacio DMG.
- Resonance Skill digantikan dengan Mountain Roamer, memberikan  Glacio DMG.
- Jika Lion's Spirit kurang dari 10, gunakan Basic Attack untuk melakukan Stormy Kicks, memberikan  Glacio DMG. Setelah Stormy Kicks, Mid-air Attack Tail Strike dapat digunakan.
- Mengonsumsi Lion's Spirit akan memulihkan Concerto Energy.

effects.title: Lion's Spirit
effects.description:
- Lingyang dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Lion's Spirit.
- Lion's Spirit dipulihkan saat menggunakan Resonance Skill Furious Punches, Intro Skill Lion Awakens, dan Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor.
DMG dari Intro Skill Lion Awakens meningkat sebesar 50%.

Saat berada dalam Forte Circuit Striding Lion state, dalam 3 detik setelah setiap Basic Attack, Resonance Skill Mountain Roamer berikutnya akan memberikan  Glacio DMG tambahan sebesar 150% dari Mountain Roamer DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG).
Lingyang memasuki medan pertempuran, memberikan  Glacio DMG.
Lingyang melepaskan gelombang kejut di sekitar target, memberikan  Glacio DMG sebesar 587.94% dari ATK Lingyang kepada musuh dalam jangkauan.
Selama Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor, Anti-Interruption Lingyang diperkuat.
Intro Skill Lion Awakens memulihkan tambahan 10 Resonance Energy untuk Lingyang. Dapat dipicu sekali setiap 20 detik.
Selama Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor:
- Basic Attack DMG Bonus Lingyang meningkat 20%.
- Resonance Skill DMG Bonus meningkat 10%.
Outro Skill Frosty Marks meningkatkan  Glacio DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim sebesar 20% selama 30 detik.

sequences.name: Seven Stars Shine, Stepped Upon High

effects.description: Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor memberikan tambahan  Glacio DMG sebesar 200% dari ATK Lingyang
Dalam Forte Circuit Striding Lion state, selama 3 detik pertama setelah setiap Resonance Skill Mountain Roamer, Basic Attack DMG Bonus untuk Basic Attack berikutnya meningkat sebesar 100%.

Info.Title: No Description Available
Info.Content: An enthusiastic, brave member of the <te href=850130>Liondance Troupe</te> in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, Lingyang is a sincere, compassionate visitor of the human community with incredible physical abilities, whose interest in humans easily shows. With his unique style, he embodies the spirit of <te href=850131>Liondance</te>.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1888-G]
Resonator Lingyang's age and time of Awakening remain uncertain, and he appears to have Awakened a long time ago. Lingyang has endured prolonged exposure to harsh environmental conditions and may have naturally activated his Forte during combat.

Lingyang bears a Tacet Mark on his right arm. No Post-Awakening mutations have been noted.

His physical endurance and strength are exceptional, likely due to his exposure to extreme environments. He displays advanced skills and agility in combat and survival, but lacks experience utilizing his Forte as it is not habitually used. Further evaluation is necessary to determine if proper guidance in Forte usage is needed.

Under the influence of his Forte, Lingyang's senses are heightened and he can generate an invisible freezing Gusto within a limited area. This also creates a low-temperature field that exerts pressure on nearby enemies. Additionally, Lingyang can influence and motivate the emotions of those near him through his transmitted will.

No instances of Resonance Spectrum Patterns similar to Lingyang's have been encountered. The cause of his Awakening remains unknown at this time.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a gradual rise. Therefore, Lingyang is identified as a Natural Resonator.

"What? So his 'beast-like' appearance wasn't a result of his Forte? What exactly is this..."

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
Resonator Lingyang's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is regular with stable peak values, and no abnormal waveforms are observed.
Resonant Criticality: Very stable. Resonator Lingyang possesses a rather high Criticality level. The risk of Overclocking is very low.
Resonator Lingyang has no past record of Overclocking. He displays proficient control over his Forte, consistently maintaining emotional stability. When utilizing his ability, known as "Will Transmission," the low-temperature field generated primarily benefits Lingyang's allies. In group situations, this reduces the overall Overclocking risk for Lingyang. It is recommended to keep Lingyang's risk level low and regularly monitor his progress. Further observation is advised.
